      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"

    {
      "name": "Tiny Dancers, Gellert Community Centre",

      "when": "Saturdays 8:30-9:00 AM, Sep 26 - Dec 12",
      "price": "$117.00 for 12 classes",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    },
    {
      "name": "Parent & Tot Skating, Town of Halton Hills arenas",
      "age_fit": "Children under 6 years accompanied by an adult on the ice",

      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    }

- **Gymnastics:** 
The Fall 2026 session runs 14 (13) weeks, September 12 to December 18, and registration opens July 20th.
 The Saturday times come from 
their fall schedule PDF
. I did not see a price on the pages I read, so I left it out.
- **Tiny Dancers:** The day, time, dates and fee come from 
the Town's fall 2026 children's dance schedule
.
- **Parent & Tot Skating:** The Town's page describes it as 
for children under 6 years of age who are accompanied by an adult on the ice
. The fees are 
Adult $4.00, child $2.50
. The page I read had no fall days or times, so I left `when` out.
